transaction_trace.finding: Provider calls completed outside interactive transactions. Chatty persistence transactions exceeded Prisma's five-second interactive transaction lifetime against the evaluation database.

case_findings.root_cause: Initial-profile persistence combined profile writes, concept-unit updates, redundant ownership reads, conversation creation, lifecycle-event reads, and telemetry-counter writes in one default-timeout interactive transaction. The transaction expired before conversation creation committed.
case_findings.atomicity_result: The transaction rolled back; no partial conversation or agent call was persisted.

case_findings.root_cause: The valid recommendation and tutor turn persisted, but transition persistence combined reads, canonical validation, profile creation, transition writes, evidence references, session updates, review signals, and final projection in a default-timeout interactive transaction that expired.
case_findings.oracle_adjudication: The student independently corrected and transferred the reliability-validity distinction but did not demonstrate standard-error-of-measurement understanding. Largely improved was better supported than sound; the V7 exact-sound assertion was overconstrained.
case_findings.atomicity_result: The transition transaction rolled back; the tutor turn and AgentCall remained valid and no partial transition was exposed.

case_findings.root_cause: The same initial-profile and conversation-creation transaction used by Case 3 expired before commit.

case_findings.root_cause: The valid recommendation and tutor turn persisted, but the oversized transition transaction expired before the transition and provenance graph committed.
case_findings.oracle_adjudication: The teacher-assistance recommendation was supported and the V7 assertion was not defective.
case_findings.atomicity_result: The transition transaction rolled back without a partial transition.
